protocol.architecture: Existing frozen MiniLM encoder plus fresh 384->128->7 MLP, dropout .3
protocol.scope: Restricted two-narrative exploratory follow-up; all seven labels and unclear allowed in annotation.
protocol.entity_guard: Original confident entity surface spans must still appear, allowing case and punctuation normalization; new confident spans must be traceable to original.
protocol.meaning_gate: Independent MPNet cosine and bidirectional DeBERTa NLI plus entities, numbers, negation presence/count, certainty, attribution, framing anchors. Human validation pending.
protocol.acceptance_selection: No narrative prediction is consulted to select or accept a rewrite. One attempt per arm, no classifier-driven retries.
protocol.primary_cohort: Intersection of all four accepted arms, identical source rows for every comparison.

caution: Entity spans, negation counts and lexical anchors can miss scope/actor changes and reject legitimate reformulations. Passing is a screen, not validated semantic equivalence.
